_readme.description: Doctor management bot — receives booking notifications and handles doctor commands
commands: today / 1 / ဒီနေ့ — Show today's appointments
tomorrow / 2 / မနက်ဖြန် — Show tomorrow's appointments
all / 3 / အားလုံး — Show all upcoming appointments
cancel NAME — Cancel appointment by patient name
setup: 1. Create a NEW Telegram bot via @BotFather → /newbot
3. In n8n: Credentials → New → Telegram API → paste token
4. Name the credential exactly: Doctor Telegram account
5. Google Sheets credential name: Google Sheets account
7. In workflow 1 (booking bot): replace YOUR_DOCTOR_CHAT_ID with your personal Telegram chat ID
8. To find your chat ID: message @userinfobot on Telegram
9. Import this workflow → assign credentials → Activate
10. Message your new doctor bot: 'today' to test
